messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: RSQLite 1.1-1 incompatibility
parts:
A poster on stack overflow found a problem that can occur with the new RSQLite 1.1-1 when used with sqldf.  If you are having problems then roll back RSQLite to RSQLite 1.0.0 like this:

    devtools::install_url("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/RSQLite/RSQLite_1.0.0.tar.gz")

sqldf must already be installed in the usual way BEFORE issuing the above command.  The order is important.
